title: RunResult
description: Proof engine -> Brain. Emitted on every run. Brain is only invoked when status != pass.

session_id.description: uuid4, stable per student per problem

reference_id.description: which reference solution was differentially tested against

failing_input.description: null when status == pass. Shrunk to smallest reproducer before it leaves this service.

original_repr.description: pre-shrink input, for the 'we found this from N cases' line

actual.description: student output on failing_input; absent on error/timeout

exception.description: exception class + message, no host paths

history.description: Append-only, oldest first. Capped at last 20 entries when shipped to Brain.

edit_summary.description: one line: what changed since the previous run

diff.description: unified diff, previous run -> this run

hint_rung_shown.description: highest rung the student had seen at this point

prediction.description: Predict-then-run. Set by the client before the run; echoed back so the gap box can render.

woke_model.description: cascade: true only when a check failed and the Brain was called

tokens_saved.description: running count of model calls skipped by the cascade this session
